description: This file contains unit tests for the QuicSocketAddress class in the QUIC protocol implementation, testing socket address initialization, conversion, normalization, and socket operations.

classes.name: QuicSocketAddress
classes.description: A class representing a network socket address used in QUIC protocol.

methods.name: Uninitialized
methods.description: Test that a default-constructed QuicSocketAddress is not initialized.

methods.name: ExplicitConstruction
methods.description: Test creation of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and their string representations.

methods.name: OutputToStream
methods.description: Test streaming a QuicSocketAddress to an output stream.

methods.name: FromSockaddrIPv4
methods.description: Test constructing QuicSocketAddress from a sockaddr_in structure.

methods.name: FromSockaddrIPv6
methods.description: Test constructing QuicSocketAddress from a sockaddr_in6 structure.

methods.name: ToSockaddrIPv4
methods.description: Test converting QuicSocketAddress to sockaddr_in structure.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Test normalization of dual-stacked IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: FromSocket
methods.description: Test creating a QuicSocketAddress from a socket file descriptor.
